notes: Bulk transcript test build (PR #339). Open a project in Edit → Transcript. Words shows the whole transcript: select individual words, or use Range and choose the first and last word of a passage. Transcript is also available from Captions.
Choose This beat or Whole Pulse. Selected words can span sentences and beats. Apply cuts removes their recorded picture and sound together; one Undo restores the entire batch, and Redo reapplies it.

Clean up → Analyze finds transcribed um/uh-style fillers and measured quiet pauses. Use Pause length to change the minimum pause. Review each proposal, uncheck any you want to keep, and use Listen before applying.

Pause detection reads the actual audio, retains a little breathing space, and skips muted or no-audio beats. Entirely quiet material needs an explicit selection. Very quiet speech can resemble silence, so review proposals before Apply cuts.

Filler matching only finds words present in the transcript; some speech models omit ums. Words such as like and so are kept by default. Edit and Hide word still change captions only. Separate narration keeps its draft-clock placement.

Try Undo/Redo, close and reopen the project, restart Pulse, then export. The saved timeline and export should agree. Please test natural speech cut quality and one-hand reach. Android UI and variable-frame-rate footage still need verification.
